2026-10-11

code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v5.1.30 Stable2026-10-11T14:45:43Z

ulw-research reads sources in your own browser instead of fetching them. The Phase 0 brief now decides Collection: search-only | browser by one rule (search-only only when a result snippet settles every axis), and the web workers read every candidate through the browser skill's attached engine: one named session per worker, one tab per source, several tabs side by side while comparing, with a full-page screenshot per top source. webfetch is reserved for raw files, hosts the browser cannot open go to ultimate-browsing with their provenance, and a team member's brief names the browser skill to read since members cannot carry load_skills. ultimate-browsing no longer presents itself as the research browsing lane, and the browser skill no longer sends plain page reading elsewhere. (#9958, #9959)

Your first real prompt starts onboarding, not opening a session. First-run context now rides along with the first prompt you actually send, without a separate model turn. The agent answers your request first, then offers the tour. Background, preview and headless sessions no longer use up onboarding, the TUI shows a static welcome until you ask something, and a failed or aborted first turn frees onboarding to try again. --onboard still starts the tour right away in the TUI, and in RPC it applies to the first real prompt. (#9905, #9907)

Custom category models keep their own reasoning settings when background work starts or resumes. A category with a model override or a models chain no longer inherits the builtin category's variant. Reasoning is resolved against the model actually selected before dispatch, with reasoning taking precedence over reasoningEffort and the legacy variant, and a resumed task keeps that model's generation settings. Builtin categories keep their existing defaults. Thanks to @MoerAI, @willowite and @pointfish6660. (#8510, #9013)

Groundwork for OmO accounts: omo login, omo whoami and omo logout ship ahead of the account service, which hasn't launched yet. Until it does, omo login checks the service first and stops at once with a one-line error naming the service address, instead of opening a browser or waiting, and omo whoami reports that you aren't signed in. When the service launches, sign-in will use a browser flow or a headless device-code flow (--device or --no-browser), keep credentials and device keys only in the operating system's credential store (Keychain on macOS, Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows) with no plaintext fallback, and keep a sign-in through connection and browser-launch failures. (#9829, #9811, #9831, #9833)

A child stopped during parent teardown no longer briefly reports a failure of its own. An unexpected exit is now held for a two-second confirmation window. If the owning manager survives, a genuine failure is reported; if the owner exits first, recovery records the interrupted work as lost without replaying it. Recovery also revisits children it had deferred to another live owner once that owner has exited, so those records no longer stay stranded. (#9715, #9884)

One task call can submit more than 16 child tasks. The per-call batch cap is gone from both validation and execution. Global, provider and model concurrency limits still decide how many children run at once; the rest queue and start as slots free up. Synchronous batch results still come back in input order. (#9854, #9859)

unspecified-low uses GPT-6.1 Sol at medium reasoning on the OpenAI lanes. The default chain adds gpt-6.1-sol for OpenAI API and ChatGPT Subscription ahead of the older GPT fallback. GPT-5.6 Terra is replaced by GPT-5.6 Sol at medium reasoning, which keeps a supported fallback for GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and catalogs without 6.1 Sol. Other categories keep their defaults. (#9844, #9845)

Windows hook commands and plugin updates no longer open extra console windows. Claude-compatible hooks and helper probes now hide their child consoles, so a GUI-launched session doesn't get a terminal flash or a focus-stealing window on every hook. The shared Bun spawn path applies the same setting, and OmO's Codex plugin hides consoles for background updates, version checks and manual-update commands. (#7144, #9837, #9840, #9841, #9838, #9839)

OpenCode session tools can find sessions across projects, not just the current server directory. Session listing and cross-session search use the paginated global session endpoint when it's available, keep their project and date filters, and fall back to the existing session list when it isn't. Search still caps how many sessions it scans. Thanks to @MoerAI. (#5810, #9023)

Computer use can inspect and select macOS menu-bar commands by their menu path. win.menu.items(path?) lists titles, paths, enabled and checked states, submenus and shortcuts, and win.menu.select(path) invokes one unambiguous, enabled leaf command. Selection re-checks the target window and command right before dispatch and restores the keyboard context afterwards. Ambiguous labels, disabled items and submenu-only targets are refused, and on macOS an app with several windows is refused rather than risking the wrong one. The API is cross-platform, but native support in this release is macOS only. (#9875, #9881, #9886)

Setting a macOS popup now picks the option instead of reporting an ignored write as success. el.setValue(text) opens the popup's menu, selects the exact matching option and verifies the result. Missing, ambiguous and disabled options are refused with the available choices. A menu the call opened is closed again whether selection succeeds or fails, while one that was already open is left alone. Pull-down popups aren't supported yet. (#9852)

Computer use can write ISO-8601 values to macOS date and time controls. el.setValue(text) now writes a native date and reads it back to verify. A date-only value keeps the current time of day, local date-times use the system time zone, and values with Z or a numeric offset name an exact instant. Malformed input, and local times that daylight saving skips or repeats, are refused rather than quietly shifted. (#9853)

Computer-use timeout messages show where the desktop engine stopped answering. A failed startup probe now names its handshake phase: neither reply yet, engine.hello answered while capabilities are pending, or capabilities answered while engine.hello is pending. A stalled engine is easier to diagnose when every timeout no longer looks the same. Thanks to @MoerAI. (#9720, #9742, #9916)

Foreground computer use now needs your explicit OK. Before the model can type, click in the foreground or raise a window, its computer code calls desktop.control.acquire({ reason }), and OmO asks you to confirm with that reason. Only an explicit yes grants control; declining, letting the 45-second prompt time out, a headless run or a read-only run all leave it ungranted. The grant ends when the model releases it, when the run ends or fails, on the stop chord, or when the session closes, and resuming never restores it. One session's grant is never taken over by another. Background delivery is unchanged and stays the default. (#9899, #9908)

Thread bindings accept WhatsApp as a native platform. thread_bind and the session-gateway store now accept whatsapp instead of refusing a connector's first message, and existing bindings are kept as the store upgrades. This is the core binding support a WhatsApp connector needs; it doesn't install or link one by itself. (#9871)

Workflow node IDs are checked before their results are stored. Empty IDs, . and .., path separators, colons and NUL bytes are rejected with invalid_node_id instead of being used to build result paths, and the result store refuses unsafe paths too. An existing run whose node IDs contain those characters can't resume its saved results after upgrading: rename the nodes and restart the run. Thanks to @DeryFerd. (#9869)

Mass-ulw joins adjacent all-to-all waves through one review node. The planning guide now puts a single verification node between two complete waves instead of drawing every producer-to-consumer edge. A finding reruns only the producer it names, and a consumer that needs just one branch waits on that branch's review alone. (#9866)

omo.dev download stats are set to refresh hourly. The downloads worker now schedules its rollup at 17 minutes past each hour, so the public stats update regularly once the worker runs with its analytics credential. Nothing changes in your local install. (#9827)

omo runs on senpi 2026.10.11, and a task shard stops soon after the session that owns it exits. Task shards are now started with senpi's caller-lifetime ownership, so a multi-GB p-* shard host no longer stays resident for the full idle window after its owning session quits; peers and running turns still keep it alive. The engine also waits for its host child to really exit before releasing a stopped host, and required compaction no longer wedges on an unsafe newest message. Long sessions stop rewriting the prompt cache every turn: context reduction holds a stable prefix between large steps and survives restarts. OpenAI models behind a Responses-compatible gateway no longer fail every turn with Invalid value: 'allowed_tools'. The footer shows a reasoning model's level as effort <level> next to the key that changes it (shift+tab by default) when the footer has room. Reloading a session no longer keeps the previous extension runner in memory, and the runtime snapshot a first launch builds leaves out dependency development trees and redundant TypeScript sources. Full engine notes: senpi 2026.10.10-12 and senpi 2026.10.11. (code-yeongyu/senpi#3044, code-yeongyu/senpi#3054, code-yeongyu/senpi#3060, code-yeongyu/senpi#900, code-yeongyu/senpi#3080, code-yeongyu/senpi#3090, code-yeongyu/senpi#3066, code-yeongyu/senpi#3083, #9876, #9976)

Suspended children no longer linger in the task list: each one resumes or ends on its own. A child that was parked while it could not run is now revived as soon as it can be, or ends within a bounded recovery window with one final result, so it never sits in the task list as suspended. Messages sent to it meanwhile are queued and delivered in order when it resumes; if it can't resume, the parent is told in that one result how many messages were not delivered, and task_output then shows error rather than the original status. (#9861, #9868)

openclaw/openclaw ↗ 2 releases · 1 stable · 1 prerelease
v2026.10.5-beta.1openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.1 Prerelease2026-10-11T13:08:24Z

2026.10.5-beta.1

Highlights

  • Safer updates: updates finish across devices, filesystems, Windows elevation, and interrupted activations, and recover from stale leases or changed evidence instead of stranding the install or blocking future updates. (#164636, #164769, #165257, #165863, #166548, #166695, #168043, #166394, #167302) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @MrJanvar, @Shirleyyyhk, @farisoftfry, @neilofneils404, and @shanselman.
  • Restart-safe conversations: interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #165502, #167570, #163258, #166010, #167662) Thanks @masatohoshino, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
  • Faster, steadier Gateway: session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, and startup maintenance runs after readiness so busy Gateways stay responsive. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Reliable turns and subagents: turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, and expired ChatGPT websockets, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through follow-ups, restarts, and expired delivery windows. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167063, #167972, #164282, #168068, #166846, #166139, #165987) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, @Jackten, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @stackingrockss, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, and @LifeViwer.
  • X channel: answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
  • Voice calls: voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Smarter model pickers: pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and stay responsive while catalogs load. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #165989) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @dprev.
  • ClawHub in the Gateway: browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

Changes

  • Sessions: allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
  • Worker-local inference: add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Public threads: open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
  • Subagent progress: count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • X channel: add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Automation repair: let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Channel progress: show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
  • Skills: keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Memory: explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
  • Models and catalogs: show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Anthropic and Claude CLI: support Claude Haiku 5.5, show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#166706, #167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • OpenAI: support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @obviyus.
  • Tool rows and subagent progress: show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd and @sunlit-deng.
  • Voice calls: add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI subagents: show when a chat is waiting on subagents, open the Subagents panel from the chat's subagent count and names, and surface child failures and attention in the parent chat. (#164190, #166142, #166224, #166312, #166347) Thanks @shakkernerd and @vincentkoc.
  • Control UI customization: let themes customize Control UI branding, use agent avatars or unlocked Lobsterdex icons for browser tabs, choose favicon shapes, and add seven Lobsterdex character variants. (#168027, #165201, #166325, #167809, #159815) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jacobtomlinson, and @hannesrudolph.
  • Terminal: add configurable terminal fonts with built-in Nerd Font icons. (#166180) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI navigation: copy file paths from chat tooltips, pin agents directly from the switcher, make agent menus easier to scan, let users hide a session's branch PR row, and simplify optional question cards. (#164431, #165640, #165641, #166366, #168040, #150587) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @RomneyDa.
  • Skill Workshop: show each skill with its changes, files, and history in one view. (#167440) Thanks @obviyus.
  • iOS: connect the Gateway through native Cloudflare Access with app-owned browser and profile admission. (#147244, #147238) Thanks @vincentkoc, @Solvely-Colin, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
  • ClawHub: browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills through the Gateway. (#163459) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Plugins: let plugin tools deliver their finished reply without a second model turn, allow every loaded plugin its own state and ingress queues and queue modes, and select plugin-owned self-hosted executors. (#164558, #165063, #165965, #161609) Thanks @mbelinky and @sjf-oa.
  • Plugins: pick the newest official plugin release the running OpenClaw supports and keep a working plugin when its matching release is unavailable. (#167485, #166588) Thanks @charlesBerg-ux.
  • Workboard: pin, unpin, and delete boards from the sidebar, keep card notes selectable with a roomier notes editor, and keep column edits on rename. (#165020, #166625, #167348) Thanks @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, and @obviyus.
  • GitHub: support asynchronous PR merges and compact the Publish PR card. (#163579, #165219) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Session performance: serve per-turn session projections, entry reads, authority checks, compaction reads, and first-turn headers from worker threads to keep the Gateway main thread responsive. (#164779, #165028, #165205, #165406, #165401, #165581, #165819, #165027, #165367, #164747, #164989, #165073)
  • Session list and search performance: stop Control UI list refresh bursts, bound list materialization, scope and prefilter transcript search, speed up cold suggestion lists, and retain previews across metadata edits. (#162280, #164764, #165080, #165089, #165570, #165150, #165834, #165096, #165932, #166635, #165887, #167909)
  • Turn database performance: reduce SQLite statements, worker requests, and redundant reads per chat turn, batch snapshot and metadata queries, and reuse admitted schema and reader facts. (#164490, #166041, #166053, #166054, #166074, #166102, #166541, #166503, #166519, #166698, #167278, #167686, #167685, #167690, #167932, #167046, #166966, #166925, #167291, #166703, #167029, #165360, #165193)
  • State database performance: speed up cold agent database admission and crash recovery, reuse integrity checks on clean restarts, stop reopening executors when switching agents, and release leases promptly during shutdown. (#164846, #165070, #165186, #165293, #165680, #166112, #165993, #167001, #168008, #164788, #164962, #165085, #165910, #166822)
  • Maintenance and history performance: lighten idle and manual maintenance, lifecycle cleanup, archive, reset, and trajectory retention work, and speed history reads with nested tool activity. (#164851, #164755, #164938, #165081, #165082, #165254, #165090, #165074, #165274, #165678, #167268, #167070, #167549, #167643, #168013, #167449, #165221, #165181, #165093, #165086, #165111, #165377, #165495, #165909, #166069, #166631, #166778, #166804, #167434, #167915, #167959) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @obviyus.
  • Agent performance: reduce retained heap, per-turn prompt allocations, transcript reads, and main-thread SQLite work during runs, preserve prompt cache across instruction refreshes and image cleanup, and reuse verified history images across turns. (#167454, #167922, #167682, #167547, #167698, #167613, #167355, #167938, #165142, #165404, #167282, #164685, #165012, #165410, #165370, #165552) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Model catalog performance: speed up multi-provider catalog refreshes, avoid discovery on cold account reads and unrequested plugin catalogs, retain account catalogs during refresh, and reduce catalog worker heap. (#167101, #167334, #167359, #167009, #167008, #166007, #166434, #165911, #165708, #165547, #165034, #165491, #166602) Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @xialonglee.
  • Subagent and ACP performance: reduce startup registry restore latency, move bulk registry work off the Gateway thread, batch registry cohorts, and avoid full-session scans when resuming ACP sessions. (#165942, #165684, #165098, #167684, #167010, #167372, #165550, #167086)

Fixes

  • Session data safety: preserve user input and committed facts through restart recovery and failed publication, keep accepted locked appends settled before releasing the writer, and fence cross-store worker commits. (#165502, #167570, #165894, #168018, #168029)
  • Session authority and privacy: check caller authority before restoring cold history for compaction, keep authority current after committed session changes, reject malformed hook session keys, and hide pre-session edits to branch-added files from uncommitted diffs. (#166506, #167875, #166406, #164671) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
  • Session cleanup: remove leftover GitHub publication receipts and managed worktrees on cleanup and Incognito reset, and publish conversation, plugin-state, sandbox, worktree, and GitHub authority receipts. (#163833, #165185, #167731, #168025) Thanks @jayzhou2309 and @obviyus.
  • Turn reliability: recover agent turns when the database worker exits mid-operation, stop unrelated session writes from failing Codex and chat turns, keep Knowledge calls working while a session publishes its bookkeeping, and stop group turns from failing silently when history cannot load. (#163258, #165196, #166010, #166758, #135253, #166059) Thanks @goutamadwant, @hawkit, @jalehman, and @izshaw.
  • Restart recovery: settle sessions left running after restart, avoid duplicate recovery after ordinary interruptions, keep recovery reconciliation on the host, and preserve database admission, custody, and hook retries for post-restart and first-session turns. Fixed

  • Fixed Bedrock Claude Fable 5.1 requests with thinking off and a forced tool choice sending the forced choice next to adaptive thinking; the choice now falls back to auto (#15316 by @harshaygadekar)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

v18.9.0 Stable2026-10-11T08:08:01Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed

  • Fixed stale queue updates when queued steering is adopted, withdrawn, or added to the transcript, ensuring queue listeners consistently receive the latest state.

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes

  • Removed the retainTextSignature option from consumeGoogleStream and streamGoogleGenAI; Google routes now consistently preserve text reply signatures.
  • Custom SessionsApi implementations must implement permits(provider, sessionId, credentialId).

Added

  • Exported matchesReplacementCredential and isSameOAuthAccount to help identify credential replacement and account ownership.
  • Added AuthStorage.sessions.permits(provider, sessionId, credentialId) for checking whether a stored account may serve a session restricted to an account pool.
  • Added judgeQuestions() for loading judge questions from JSON with inferred choice labels and answer types, plus renderQuestion() for templated instructions.

Changed

  • Devin chat turns now use the native Devin CLI sampling settings by default, while continuing to honor explicitly configured temperature, top-p, and stop sequences.
  • Added parentSessionId and minimizeEffort stream options. Branched side requests can reuse a conversation's prompt cache, and supported models can run them at their lowest effort without losing cache reuse.
  • Improved cross-host continuation for supported models so confirmed prior reasoning is preserved as reasoning context rather than exposed as <think> text in replies.

Fixed

  • Fixed Anthropic subscription quota not appearing in /usage when an OAuth token is supplied through ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
  • Fixed custom OpenAI-compatible Responses streams truncating reasoning and incorrectly invoking custom tools with empty input.
  • Fixed Codex WebSocket prewarming so optional service tiers and model routing are handled consistently with normal requests.
  • Fixed OAuth sign-in result pages breaking or rendering injected markup when provider errors or callback values contain special characters.
  • Fixed Anthropic requests failing when tools are added to a conversation or when resumed sessions no longer include earlier tools.
  • Fixed Anthropic requests rejecting tall or oversized historical screenshots by resizing or re-encoding images to the host's limits.
  • Improved compatibility with Anthropic-compatible endpoints that reject prompt-cache options by retrying without unsupported caching features and reporting the disabled capability.
  • LiteLLM proxy logs now group requests by omp conversation instead of displaying a separate session for each request.
  • Fixed Gemini-family integrations echoing prior thinking as visible fenced thinking blocks; thinking is now restored as model reasoning across Google, Vertex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Factory Droid routes.
  • Fixed Gemini-family integrations losing text reply signatures needed for subsequent requests across Google, Vertex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Factory Droid routes.
  • Fixed Cursor integrations losing previously recorded reasoning, including signed and redacted reasoning, when continuing or resuming a conversation.
  • Fixed invalid auth.accountPolicies entries referring to unavailable accounts from preventing startup, account selection, or login; such entries are now skipped with a warning.
  • Fixed Factory Droid Claude turns with thinking disabled from replaying unsupported earlier thinking blocks, and aligned high-effort Sonnet 5.5 thinking behavior with the native client.
  • Fixed side requests for GPT-6 Responses and Codex models from losing prompt-cache context or applying unsupported reasoning-effort configuration changes.

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed

  • Fixed GLM-5.3-FlashX on Zhipu Coding Plan so bundled context, image, and reasoning-level capabilities are reported correctly.
  • Fixed OpenRouter Decisions endpoint derivation when the chat base URL has a trailing slash.
  • Fixed GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast usage pricing to apply OpenAI's published premium rates for the OpenAI API and Codex included usage.
  • Fixed GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna so changing reasoning effort preserves prompt caching.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added browser target discovery and control, allowing agents to list the user's available pages and operate an already-open Tern browser block instead of opening a new view.
  • Added the ctx.annotations extension API for submitting and collecting /annotate feedback on text and diffs.
  • Added configurable Extra Context Files under /settings → Context, allowing custom instruction filenames without editing YAML.
  • Added optional composer predictions via composer.predictions, which suggest the user's next message as ghost text after each turn and support Tab or Right to accept the suggestion. Predictions use an additional model request and are included in session usage and /stats.
  • Added structured async job metadata exposing native job status and child-agent identity alongside the job ID.
  • Enhanced tui.autoGraph: smart with data-aware chart recommendations, including labels, grouping, ordering, shading, reference rows, measure direction, and suitable chart types.
  • Added retry.fallbackOn to restrict model fallback to quota errors (usage-limit) or to non-quota errors (except-usage-limit), while retaining any as the default.
  • Added omp usage reset commands to list saved Codex and Claude rate-limit resets and redeem a selected reset from the CLI, scripts, or auth-broker clients.
  • Added warnings for saved Codex and Claude resets that are nearing expiry, including affected accounts and redemption targets; interactive sessions also show a one-time conversation warning.
  • On macOS, the computer tool now keeps the display awake while operating and reports when the screen is locked or asleep.
  • Tern browser open results now indicate when a page is not currently visible, helping agents direct users to hidden picture-in-picture or omp-tab views.

Changed

  • Improved computer.window() failure messages by listing open windows grouped by application, with the requested application shown first.
  • Standalone binary updates and installers now use Stencil's build service with SHA-256 verification; recent updates use substantially smaller verified patches, and --binary --ref accepts release tags.
  • After an omp upgrade, an unused older browser relay started by omp is automatically replaced on the next browser call so relay fixes take effect without manual shutdown.
  • Saved Codex and Claude resets in non-interactive sessions are now automatically redeemed when they are about to expire, unless autoRedeem: no is configured.
  • Background Claude reset salvage now checks only accounts with eligible usage, reducing unnecessary usage-limit traffic.
  • Reasoning provenance is preserved when /btw answers are promoted or turns are moved, preventing provider summaries from being sent as model-generated reasoning.

Fixed

  • Fixed unconfigured judge roles incorrectly falling back to a Google Vertex Claude model instead of the configured tiny, smol, or default models.
  • Fixed omp --resume -p continuing stale todos instead of printing the answer and exiting.
  • Fixed /btw, IRC, and composer-prediction requests losing the conversation prompt cache on Codex and after thinking-level changes on GPT-6 models.
  • Fixed Tern browser operations on about:blank and no-op navigations hanging until timeout.
  • Fixed SDK and RPC sessions using stale MCP tool lists when servers changed during extension loading.
  • Fixed installing plugins from non-GitHub Git URLs and prevented inline credentials from being persisted in plugin metadata or lockfiles.
  • Improved recovery from repeated OpenAI Responses request timeouts during productive long-running sessions.
  • Fixed JavaScript eval syntax errors lacking source location and a useful code frame.
  • Fixed Collab sessions failing to reconnect after network interruptions or device sleep.
  • Fixed ACP and browser diagnostics and SSH listings using default paths instead of configured paths.
  • Fixed advisors repeatedly returning to models that refused reviewed content; they now remain on the fallback until the conversation changes state.
  • Plugin registry discovery warnings are now reported instead of silently ignored.
  • Fixed OpenRouter Decisions judge requests through custom provider base URLs returning 404 errors.
  • Fixed Codex configuration files being rejected and prevented supported settings from being ignored.
  • Fixed secrets appearing in advisor previews when a preview was truncated.
  • Restored public compatibility exports required by tools, legacy Pi extensions, and plugins.
  • Fixed slow completions ignoring explicitly configured thinking levels, including :max and :off.
  • Fixed session writes failing on Windows FSLogix profile disks.
  • Limited persisted eval status history so long-running eval cells do not excessively enlarge session files or slow resume.
  • Fixed Codex session prewarming from using a different model or service tier than the resolved session.
  • Fixed subagent completion-probe usage disappearing after parking or restarting.
  • Fixed Python eval processes hanging while waiting on the kernel control channel.
  • Corrected the custom-tool quickstart to use the supported discovery flow and shipped example.
  • Fixed browser screenshots providing incorrect coordinate-scaling guidance on high-device-scale displays.
  • Fixed browser calls hanging when a tab renderer crashed; they now fail promptly and reload or close the affected tab as appropriate.
  • Fixed sessions becoming permanently busy when retry-related session writes failed.
  • Fixed collapsed todo lists wasting a row on the hidden-item indicator.
  • Fixed concurrent SDK sessions interfering with one another's async jobs and subagent follow-up results.
  • Fixed duplicate accessibility-tree output from computer-use eval cells.
  • Fixed chained element actions such as win.ref("e5").click() throwing errors; element interaction options are now supported and documented.
  • Fixed JavaScript and Python read("artifact://N") calls returning a capped preview instead of the artifact's selected text.
  • Improved guidance for retrieving complete lines when read, eval, or bash output is truncated by the column limit.
  • Fixed resumed, switched, and forked sessions losing the prompt cache when Mnemopi or Hindsight auto-recall was enabled.
  • Fixed the first prompt losing provider prompt-cache coverage while MCP servers were still starting.
  • Fixed coordinate clicks being dropped after password-form submission in omp-launched Chromium.
  • Fixed classifier refusals ending fallback chains prematurely when the retry budget was exhausted.
  • Fixed reading MCP-advertised skill:// resources and other MCP resources, including discovery order, loading state, and clean shutdown of stalled servers.
  • Fixed smart unexpected-stop detection missing slow judge results, allowing premature stops to recover correctly.
  • The cfg:// settings approval prompt now honors ask.timeout rather than always expiring after ten seconds.
  • Fixed custom LiteLLM providers not receiving the built-in provider behavior and model/session handling.
  • Fixed resumed Cursor sessions losing earlier reasoning after transcript truncation.
  • Fixed computer.window() failing to find windows by ID or application when many windows were open.
  • Fixed grep hiding matches that appeared beyond the first 512 bytes of a long line.
  • Fixed snapcompaction leaving too little context room after compaction.
  • Fixed usage-limited account pools redeeming saved resets for accounts outside the configured pool.

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Added

  • Exported clipRecallContent for applications that need to format content consistently with Mnemopi recall previews.

Fixed

  • Fixed memory-save performance degradation and excessive memory-database growth when date-related terms such as “today” appeared in otherwise unrelated memories.

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added applyBinaryPatch(oldPath, patchPath, outPath) for applying HDiffPatch single-stream delta patches, including zstd-compressed patches, to files.
  • macOS desktop sessions now keep the display awake while in use and expose screen-lock and display-sleep state through capabilities, screenState, and screen captures.

Changed

  • Improved Linux embedded-shell startup performance for external commands.
  • Improved macOS computer-use performance, including faster screenshots and accessibility queries, with better handling of large numbers of off-screen windows.
  • Updated grep() and search() to truncate matching lines around the first match when they exceed maxColumns, mark truncated sides with ..., and report the match's character column.

Fixed

  • Fixed macOS accessibility and window-management operations requiring Screen Recording permission; only screenshots and display listing now require that permission, and window listing includes windows beyond the frontmost 48. Window titles from other applications remain unavailable without Screen Recording permission.
  • Fixed macOS menu inspection and selection for menus containing items whose titles cannot be read; those items are now skipped safely.
  • Fixed syntax highlighting and language detection for several languages, including TOML, PowerShell, SCSS, Less, Vim script, GraphQL, Protobuf, Terraform/HCL, Dockerfile, CMake, INI, gitignore, Kotlin, Swift, Elixir, Sass, Python f-strings, Julia interpolations, and Elixir interpolations.

@oh-my-pi/omp-stats

Fixed

  • Fixed the stats dashboard favicon so dashboard tabs and bookmarks display the OMP icon correctly.

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added opt-in JSON editing for free-form array settings while keeping credential values masked; settings editors now surface submission and validation errors.
  • Added ghost-text predictions to the editor via the new Editor.prediction callback. Press Tab or Right at the end of a line to accept the suggested text without submitting.
  • Expanded table-chart support with stacked, waterfall, timeline, dots, range, slope, butterfly, bullet, ladder, histogram, and stat charts, including error whiskers, share bars, status matrices, and richer before/after visualizations.
  • Added richer table-chart planning and presentation controls, including titles, ordering, grouping, shading, normalization, reference lines, polarity, rivals, focus rows, and model-driven selection for smart mode. Charts now identify key findings, highlight best values and changes, and adapt scales and labels for clearer comparisons.
  • Added the optional assistantMessageText theme token for coloring assistant reply prose while preserving the terminal default when unset or empty.
  • Added optional status-line support for showing saved usage resets that expire soon and warning once per conversation when a reset expires within 24 hours.

Changed

  • Improved table-chart planning to prefer waterfall charts over share bars for complex data sets and enforce segment limits for share-chart legibility
  • Reduced the time required to rebuild long sessions on resume, particularly sessions with repeated wait polls or todo updates.
  • Output summaries now identify the first and last lines omitted by column limits, and truncation notices point to the :raw selector for retrieving complete lines.

Fixed

  • Fixed session model selection and setup displaying role chips for roles that resolve to a non-chat runner rather than the model used by the session.
  • Improved table-chart parsing and rendering across repeated labels, grouped and paired values, percentages, units, currency, durations, model sizes, links, identifiers, and sparse or side-by-side tables. Charts now avoid duplicate or misleading plots and preserve meaningful comparisons.
  • Fixed table-chart scaling for outliers, stacked groups, zeros, logarithmic shading, and values spanning multiple orders of magnitude.
  • Fixed /tree stalling or using excessive memory when opened on long sessions with many branch points.
  • Fixed extension status messages losing SGR colors and text styles in the status line.
  • Fixed the eval status list omitting status events discarded from long-running cells.
  • Fixed loop-blocked diagnostics to attribute stalls to the correct work phase or terminal writes instead of reporting misleading unknown causes.
  • Fixed Agent Hub and status-line spending totals losing cumulative subagent costs after compaction, parking, or follow-up turns.
  • Fixed dead-key input on older Windows Terminal versions so quotes are entered correctly with Space, Enter, and Tab.
  • Fixed SIXEL graphics detection on terminals, including native Windows Terminal, so SVG figures and inline images work without forcing a graphics protocol.
  • Fixed overflow transcript rendering so user messages no longer appear as blank padding bars or leave stray prompt markers across terminal rows.

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Breaking Changes

  • Renamed takeRecentLoopPhase() to takeLoopPhaseAttribution(). The new API returns a LoopPhaseAttribution object ({ label, ms }) and reports a label only when it accounts for more time than unlabeled work within an armed measurement window.

Added

  • Added withLoopPhase(label, fn) for attributing synchronous work to a named loop phase, with automatic cleanup even when the callback throws.

Changed

  • Improved streaming JSON parsing performance for long tool-argument payloads.

Fixed

  • Fixed archive extraction on Windows systems without symlink privileges by allowing symlink entries to be extracted using supported fallbacks, while skipping unresolvable dangling links instead of failing the entire archive.

v18.8.9 Stable2026-10-10T17:15:16Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Changed

  • Updated state field rendering to trim trailing whitespace and normalize empty collection formatting for consistent prompt output

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added capability-driven extension terminal launches for tmux, Zellij, Herdr, and CMUX, with consolidated multiplexer detection, provider/shell capability feedback, and required POSIX-shell confirmation for shell-input launches; CMUX shell input preserves non-ASCII arguments and pane working directories (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Added /fork pane|window|tab to open a fork of the session in a new multiplexer pane or window while this session keeps running; bare /fork still forks in place (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Added Orca CLI-based launches for /fork pane|window|tab and ctx.ui.openTerminal(), with POSIX-shell confirmation; when Orca can only start a tab as a background terminal, the launch reports a warning instead of a visible tab (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).

Changed

  • CLI --fork now pairs tool calls the source session left unresolved with an unknown-outcome result, and /tan clones report such calls as unknown-outcome instead of aborted; forking a source whose process already exited keeps the process-exit recovery and pending-tool warning (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Table charts (tui.autoGraph) now cover before/after tables whose rows are different metrics (time, memory, counts): each row's change is drawn as a factor of its "before" value (48× less, +27%), and rows written in prose are skipped and named under the chart. A single column of scores like 12/12 is drawn as bars filling toward 100%
  • In terminals that speak the Tern Surface Protocol (Tern), the composer's bottom bar shows the git branch and its status beside the model chip when the status line has the git segment; it outlasts the other facts as the bar narrows, and clicking it opens /git (#15220 by @H4vC)
  • Table charts plot scores like 154/160 as the share of their total instead of the first number, and tables comparing two or three columns across four or more metrics now get a chart: a grid of one small panel per metric

Fixed

  • Fixed table charts failing on a table cell such as 3 constructor or 2 valueOf calls

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • Removed the isInsideTmux(), isInsideZellij(), and isInsideHerdr() exports; use hasTerminalMultiplexerSession("tmux" | "zellij" | "herdr", env) instead (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

Added

  • classifyTerminalMultiplexer() reports "orca" inside Orca terminals while isInsideTerminalMultiplexer() stays false there, so Orca keeps the direct-terminal render path; TERMINAL_MULTIPLEXER_ENV_KEYS lists every environment variable multiplexer detection reads (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Added terminalMultiplexerSessions(), terminalMultiplexerForTerm(), classifyTerminalMultiplexerModule(), and routeTerminalMultiplexerNotification(), driven by one multiplexer registry that now owns notification routing and per-multiplexer capability overrides (#13620 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Added change and progress table-chart kinds with ChartSpec.baseline and TableColumn.scores: a before/after table whose rows have their own units charts each metric as a factor of the baseline column (rows without two numbers are named in the caption), and analyzeTable reads whole-number scores (12/12, 154/160) as the percent of their total, keeping a / b pairs and lists as written

Changed

  • StatusLineComponent.describeComposerFacts() includes the configured git segment among the composer's facts (branch and status, the status.git click action, pinned so it outlasts the other facts) instead of leaving the branch to Tern's pane header (#15220 by @H4vC)
  • Small-multiple table charts with more than three panels and at most six categories draw as bands of per-metric panels with a color legend, and worthCharting counts their panels like categories
  • Table charts take the look of Apple's charts and Tern: a UI sans, hairline gridlines, rounded bars and cells, smooth lines over a soft area fill, dot legends, left-aligned category labels that never run off the edge, and axes labeled in one unit (0, 5k, 10k)
  • Line charts whose series differ 8× or more in size stack panels on their own axes instead of flattening the smaller lines, and their end labels no longer overlap
  • SVG figure series colors --c1…--c6 are an even-weight palette led by the theme accent's hue instead of syntax colors

Fixed

  • Fixed parseCell throwing on table cells such as 3 constructor or 2 valueOf calls, and reading a constructor cell as a missing value

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added

  • Added hueDistance, the angular distance between two OKLCH hues

What's Changed

  • feat(tui): show the git branch in Tern's composer bar by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15220
  • feat(coding-agent): add multiplexer terminal launch and /fork placements by @anatoli-tsinovoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620

v18.8.8 Stable2026-10-10T15:02:52Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added

  • Added Agent.setModelResolver() to fit every model an agent adopts (via setModel, starting with the current one) before it is used (#15048 by @H4vC)
  • Added CompactionSettings.baseWindowTokens: when set, resolveThresholdTokens() scales its percentage or reserve-based threshold from that base instead of the full context window (#15065 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed OpenAI V1 remote compaction re-attaching a prior Anthropic native payload after a successful compact (#15041 by @PaleRoses)
  • Fixed resolveThresholdTokens() clamping a positive thresholdTokens to baseWindowTokens; a fixed threshold is checked against the real window, and the base only rescales the percentage and reserve policies (#15074 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed resolveThresholdTokens() clamping a fixed thresholdTokens at or past the context window to one token below it, so compaction fired only after the next request overflowed; it now clamps to the window less the reserve (#15146 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed OpenAI Responses and Codex tool calls running with empty {} arguments when a compatible host or proxy ends the call with an empty arguments payload after streaming the real ones (#15099 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed truncated Factory Droid Gemini responses ending as a hard error or a half-received tool call instead of being retried (#15103 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Gemini ignoring an error the server reports mid-response, which hid its status and retried errors that cannot succeed (#15103 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed resumed OpenAI Responses sessions (xAI, Factory Droid, OpenAI and other hosts) dropping all earlier encrypted reasoning on their first request; GitHub Copilot still rebuilds history until its first response (#15148 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Fixed

  • Fixed tabs a relay client asks to open in the background being created as the selected tab (#15109 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added the connection-bound-native-history rule axis for Responses hosts that reject native history items from an earlier connection, set for GitHub Copilot (#15148 by @will-bogusz)

Fixed

  • Fixed Devin's discovered models not marking the account's default model, the one Devin's own CLI starts the account on (SWE-2 High on Pro, SWE-1.6 Slow on Free); when it is an effort lane of a family, the family starts at that effort. Cursor's discovered models no longer carry that marker, so Cursor keeps its existing startup selection (#15115 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added /jobs kill <id>|all to cancel a running background job (or every one this session owns) from the command line, even while the agent is busy (#14160 by @KanwarGill)
  • Added omp anonymize [session] [-o dir] to write a shareable copy of a session and its subagent transcripts: only an explicit allowlist of omp metadata (ids, timestamps, models, usage, built-in tool names and options) is kept; message, thinking, and tool-output text become size-annotated [redacted …] markers; tool-call paths become mock paths (/home/seg3/seg4/src/seg9.ts:10-20), shell commands keep known programs and flags, other literals such as a grep pattern become PLACEHOLDER_N, and extension or MCP payloads are redacted whole, with the same original always mapping to the same token across files (#15077 by @H4vC)
  • Added /dump anon, which writes the same anonymized session and subagent JSONL to a zip in the temp directory and copies its path (#15077 by @H4vC)
  • Added message times to /dump transcripts (assistant turns also show request duration and time to first token), and live status, last activity, pending tool calls, and the partially streamed turn to /dump all files for subagents still running, so a stuck subagent can be diagnosed from the archive (#15121 by @H4vC)
  • Added contextFiles.extra to load extra instruction files, such as AGENTS.local.md, beside the usual context file (#15147 by @Shadorain).
  • /annotate opens the note you are writing, a file or typed-prompt source, or (for local diff reviews) the current working-tree file in $VISUAL or $EDITOR with the external-editor key (Ctrl+G by default); a file source is saved back and its notes follow the edited text (#15151 by @Shadorain)

Changed

  • A /models compaction limit set past a model's standard context window now runs that model on its extended window instead of being silently clamped; the hub warns (noting long-context pricing) and saves on a second Enter, in the terminal and in Tern, and rejects limits past the model's largest window (#15048 by @H4vC)
  • A token compaction limit set in /models (or compaction.modelThresholds) is now the base omp scales with its usual policy, as if it were the model's window (85% of it by default for bases above ~109k, or compaction.thresholdPercent of it), instead of the exact point. Plain numbers saved since 18.8.5 therefore compact earlier; rewrite one as "f<tokens>" (or type f400k in the hub) to keep it an exact trigger. The /models limit field shows where the model would compact as you type (compacts at 340K · 85% of 400K base), the preview's Compacts at row says why, and the saved message repeats it (#15065 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed /usage (or clicking the status-line cost) while the usage dashboard was already open stacking a second dashboard on top; it now focuses the open one (#15145 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the browser tool prompt not documenting observe()'s viewportOnly and includeAll options, or that open/close/run timeouts are seconds clamped to 1–300 while waitFor* timeouts are milliseconds (#15104 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed browser relay pages opened in the background (browser.newPage({ background: true }) in tab.run) taking over the user's selected tab; they now open unselected once the relay extension is reinstalled (#15109 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed browser open with app.relay and a target failing with No page target matched or Selected tab is no longer available when the matching tab was opened a moment earlier outside omp; it now waits briefly for the relay to list the tab (#15112 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a timed-out browser.open holding up the next open of the same browser (apps launched with app.path excepted) until its abandoned launch or connect returned; the timeout error now names the step that stalled (#15117 by @jinpyo-jeon and @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed browser tabs crashing mid-load on some pages with a same-site iframe, Google Travel among them, after which every open, screenshot and evaluate on the tab timed out (#15118 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the custom-tool examples' full-documentation link opening a missing page (#15076 by @qingshungLI)
  • Fixed the /models compaction limit preview and Compacts at row rounding fractional percentages (12.5% showed as 13%) (#15074 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed /omfg save, overwrite, and validation prompts in Tern opening as a sheet over the candidate rule; they now sit in the composer slot like ask, so the rule stays readable while you choose (#15058 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed hotkeys pressed in Tern while omp is still starting (such as Alt+P for the model selector) being ignored; like in other terminals, they now take effect once startup finishes (#15120 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed a startup extension dialog (select, confirm, input) in Tern not receiving keys until it timed out (#15122 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed auto-compaction overflowing the context window every cycle when compaction.thresholdTokens or an f<tokens> model limit is at or past a window the provider caps lower (such as Factory's 196K Kimi K3); it now compacts at the window less the reserve, and /models shows the trigger as capped (#15146 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed resumed xAI, Factory Droid and OpenAI sessions forgetting earlier reasoning on their first request, while a retry after a stale Responses item error still rebuilds history (#15148 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the startup default ignoring the model a provider's discovery names as the account's default: with no model chosen, Devin Pro now starts on SWE-2 at High instead of SWE-1.6 (#15115 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Fixed

  • Fixed long retained transcripts exhausting local memory extraction models by limiting each extraction input to 8192 characters while keeping the opening context and newest turns (#14956).

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Changed

  • Reduced macOS accessibility-tree latency for ax() without changing its text output: each element's children are read once, and its bounds, which the tree never shows, are no longer read (#15159 by @will-bogusz)

Fixed

  • Fixed macOS computer use reporting AxFailed instead of StaleRef for a ref whose element the app had removed (#15156 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS el.press() and el.perform() reporting AxFailed when the app did not answer in time, such as a press that opens a modal dialog; they now report AxUnconfirmed (#15156 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • ModelHubCallbacks.onCompactionPointChange now receives a confirmed flag and returns a CompactionPointChangeResult ({ kind: "error" } or { kind: "confirm" }) instead of an error string; a confirm result shows a warning that a second Enter on the same input accepts (#15048 by @H4vC)
  • ModelCompactionPoint.percent is replaced by basis, a short explanation of why the model compacts there (fixed, 85% of 400K base, 80% of window) that the model hub preview shows next to the trigger (#15065 by @H4vC)

Added

  • Added an inline option to HookSelectorComponent that keeps a selector in the composer slot in Tern instead of opening it as a sheet over the screen (#15058 by @H4vC)
  • Added ModelHubCallbacks.previewCompactionPoint, whose line the compaction limit field shows while you type instead of the input syntax (#15065 by @H4vC)
  • Added Vim find and till motions (f, F, t, T) in the prompt editor, with ; and , to repeat them (#15100 by @Shadorain)
  • Added Vim replace (r, R) in the prompt editor (#15100 by @Shadorain)
  • Added Vim bracket and quote matching (%), paragraph motions ({, }), line join (J), and indent (>>, <<) in the prompt editor (#15100 by @Shadorain)
  • Added an external-editor key (Ctrl+G by default) to the annotation overlay for the note draft and, when the host provides onExternalEditor, the source being annotated; an edited text source is returned as editedText on the paste result (#15151 by @Shadorain)
  • Added TUI.releaseHeldInput(): on a terminal expected to speak TSP, a deferInput start now holds keystrokes (TSP events and the cell-size reply still apply; Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D release early) until the app calls it once its session is wired; such terminals also skip the sixel probe (#15120 by @H4vC)
  • Added TUI.replaceHeldFocus(previous, next), which Composer.setEditor() calls so a swapped-in editor inherits held startup keys; only keys for the start-time focus owner are now held, and a dialog that takes focus gets its input live (#15122 by @H4vC)
  • Added RenderResultOptions.elapsedMs and cancelled, NativeToolHead.command and NativeToolView.preview: "children" for native describe hooks

Changed

  • Tern draws each bash run, eval cell and !/$ run as one box: the command or code, its output, status lines and a foot with state, time and facts; images sit below the box and the bash head shows the intent instead of the command

Fixed

  • Fixed the Agents hub Time column rewinding and freezing for running subagents between progress updates (#15140 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Fixed

  • Fixed formatDuration printing 60.0s for durations just under a minute; they now read 1m (#15121 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-wire

Added

  • Added TspToolProps.command (the command line Copy command copies), TspToolProps.preview: "children" (the collapsed body stays whole while its children clamp) and TspCodeProps.preview

v0.8.146 Stable2026-10-11T04:48:23Z

HyperFrames v0.8.146

Released on 2026-10-11.

A split sub-composition now plays from its in-point in preview and on the timeline. FFmpeg installed while a preview runs is found without a restart, and exports no longer fail on a clip past the composition's end.

Features

  • Core: Truepeak, a lookahead true-peak limiter FX (3746703ea77, #5419).

Fixes

  • CLI: The browser download unpacks on machines without an unzip command (9e9b613ccf8, #5433).
  • CLI: Check warns when a video's browser-playable copy cannot be made (bf7f6deae93, #5441).
  • CLI: History reads answer while another app has the project open (489036c8439, #5445).
  • Core: A split sub-composition plays its videos from its in-point in preview and timeline (480807ec4be, #5413).
  • Parsers: Find ffmpeg installed after a long-running preview started (64c47cf3d1b, #5439).
  • Core: A runtime failure just before start-up is named too (721ebeafaa3, #5444).
  • Core: Slow clips stay on the playhead at reduced preview speeds (7d958fea0ba, #5440).
  • Producer: Exports no longer fail on a video clip outside the composition's length (81f60dbc985, #5431).
  • Parsers: Find FFmpeg and FFprobe installed by the project's npm installer packages (748cda90697, #5434).
  • Core: A runtime that fails to start names its real error instead of a half-built page (3aba29ce056, #5406).
  • CLI: Preview --background reports a preview that cannot start instead of waiting it out (6c96ea53443, #5437).
  • Lint: A double-quoted media src with an apostrophe is read whole, not reported missing (a9823f719df, #5411).
  • Studio: Studio's own text reads without em or en dashes (9825614d91d, #5414).
  • Engine: Copy border-width/style/color onto the replacement video frame (e23b3a3e31d, #3993).
  • CLI: Timeline split keeps a sub-composition's place in both halves (165be851328, #5410).

Performance

  • Packages: Ship npm packages without source maps and guard their size in CI (bb9e507e840, #5403).
  • Engine: Re-renders reuse the extracted frames of remote videos (b6467d91315, #5408).

Catalog

  • Catalog: Publish generated catalog (faa4913c9ef, #4340).
  • Ci: Let the catalog republish remove its stale simulated-cursor page and superseded fonts (f2b81b24151, #5432).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.145...v0.8.146

morluto/rea ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
rea-agents-6.4.0rea-agents: v6.4.0 Stable2026-10-11T03:58:03Z

6.4.0 (2026-10-11)

Highlights

  • Android: added device inspection, split-APK acquisition, logs, screenshots, file transfers and explicit app lifecycle actions through ADB, plus manifest and localized-string decoding with Apktool. (#1552, #1556) Thanks @3QL.
  • JEB: browse project units and decompile selected items through a caller-started local JEB MCP server. (#1536) Thanks @3QL.
  • Large analyses: discover retained Evidence without loading every payload, and inspect JavaScript graphs, binary layouts and function dossiers through summaries and selected views. (#1682, #1568, #1570, #1345, #1507, #1247) Thanks @jhuang-tw, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • JavaScript: isolate source analysis in an owned process with configurable heap and timeout limits; retain completed facts and explicit unknowns when analysis runs out of resources. (#1651, #1563, #1565) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @peter-research.
  • Ghidra: configure import language/compiler specifications and seed functions, code and labels before auto-analysis. (#1667) Thanks @sqmagellan.
  • RPC discovery: recognize supported tRPC calls, HTTP-link URLs and named GraphQL operations in JavaScript applications and web bundles. (#1670) Thanks @pompiliodonatoapp.

Changes

  • Added Ghidra support for Windows PE DLLs and bounded MIPS ELF analysis, including carved MIPS inputs with incomplete section tables. Windows P0 remains read-only. (#1303, #1362, #1629, #1290, #718, #1619) Thanks @bqw371, @jaelliot, @kvalls, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Enabled set_address_name and set_addresses_names for Ghidra sessions with mutation authority, including namespace-aware data labels and per-address batch results. (#1635, #1634) Thanks @giri256.
  • Recovered additional signed AArch64 relative jump-table patterns. (#1592) Thanks @RishTheFish21.
  • Added PE resource inspection and read-only NativeAOT metadata parsing for supported x64 PE32+/.NET 8 RTR 9.1 inputs. The NativeAOT parser’s Windows-host Ghidra workflow remains unverified on a real Windows host. (#1482, 76d8f68, #1254) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @thangldw.
  • Added Pi, Hermes and Qwen Code setup, including Hermes active-profile support. (#1376, #1403, #1415, #1409) Thanks @rasatpetabit, @yiliang114, @zaydiscold.
  • Added REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact for size-capped MCP clients such as Kimi/Moonshot, while retaining canonical runtime validation. (#1514, #1580, #1484, #1581) Thanks @haythemsellami, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Added live process-capture progress and optional finalization_ms to capture shutdown output before timeout escalation; cancellation remains immediate. (#1483, #1583, #1252, #1253, modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk#2997) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @nikolay-dementiev, @sathariels.
  • Improved Codex onboarding and recovery from observed client, PATH and provider blockers. (#1613) Thanks @N0zoM1z0.
  • Reduced redirected JSON and terminal output size, and deferred heavy imports until their commands need them. (#1413, #1450, #1439, 21dbcf7) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.

Fixes

  • Electron analysis: follow renamed and default-imported APIs and optional calls, ignore overwritten identities and media preload attributes, and resolve packaged app.asar pages and unpacked companions. (#1391, #1393, #1400, #1664, #1673) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @marnixpluim, @N0zoM1z0, @suninrain086.
  • JavaScript data flow: preserve returned/yielded reference uncertainty, invalidate property-stored aliases correctly, and retain bundled-module runtime scope. (#1437, #1445, #1471, #1577, #1428, #1442, #1449, #1576) Thanks @CassieFox23, @dakjdakd, @N0zoM1z0.
  • JavaScript packages: resolve exact exports subpaths, preserve trailing-slash directory requests and exact CommonJS keys, and respect shadowed require bindings. (#1424, #1615, 5485483, 8b2f851, f998fcb, 1e51c73, #1365) Thanks @akshitkhokhani, @AWUQAQ, @immanuwell, @rudycelekli.
  • Large JavaScript inputs: handle oversized inline source maps, deep returns and reassignment loops; avoid argument expansion limits and yield during large analysis passes. (#1386, #1368, #1390, #1539, #1525, #1542, #1545, #1557, #1380, #1401, #1538, #1462) Thanks @cold-atom, @KadirJeager, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @marnixpluim, @N0zoM1z0, @rudycelekli.
  • JavaScript receivers: expand escaped methods once, index returned-object targets, and avoid replaying earlier writes or duplicating retained graph allocations. (#1517, #1537, #1444, #1601, #1495) Thanks @CassieFox23, @geekwolf, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @zeynelacikgoez.
  • Browser captures: retain WebSocket URLs, empty connections and frame order; compare only common known payload coverage and preserve incomplete WebMCP replay coverage. (db4e360, aa257ea, e52c0a7)
  • Browser scenarios: seed storage in the correct partition, normalize loopback attach identities, retain declared-secret redaction and require verified lineage before Windows Electron signals. (#1604, #1590, #1588, 8b4c3de, #1497, #1591, #1589) Thanks @Adolanium, @akushonkamen, @dakjdakd.
  • Added Termux Android browser-scenario support. (#1655) Thanks @tyloryang.
  • Web inputs: accept BOM-prefixed HAR, preserve the first duplicate DOM attribute and resolve SVG/XLink URLs in HTML and XHTML. (#1509, #1516, #1602, #1683, #1496, #1586) Thanks @CassieFox23, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @sathariels, @taljeri.
  • Screenshot comparisons: validate PNG chunks, distinguish corruption from unsupported encodings and bound comparison memory. (4e4b15b, b3e977e) Thanks @rudycelekli.
  • Archives: preserve case-distinct names, report collisions at their diverging segment, detect nested formats from bytes and reject Windows alternate-stream extraction paths. (#1480, #1505, #1553, 573598c, #1470, #1491) Thanks @CassieFox23, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Cleanup: retain failed readers, ASAR handles, output trees and provider workers for retry without discarding completed output or partial observations. (ffe0574, de0d341, 3f8c51e, d1235fa, 026126e)
  • Providers: canonicalize IDA workspace roots before identity checks, respect IDA cancellation, serialize JEB acquisition and correct Ghidra no-return/imported-symbol recovery. (#1481, #1419, 5f30ea6, f88c990, 49e6f00) Thanks @AS9929, @JonahSimon, @Y0UW1SH.
  • Binary metadata: respect PE/.NET section extents, bound binary-plist expansion, scope keyed-archive traversal and decode app Info.plist files without plutil. (#1678, #1515, #1378, #1476, 975dff2, 76296c5) Thanks @jayhemnani9910, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @rudycelekli.
  • Windows runtimes: preserve drive-root paths when creating private provider directories. (ee46323)
  • Compatibility: load Windows native controls under Node-API hosts with renamed executables, preserve dylib directory requirements, support Wakaru 1.x and reject directory-valued Hopper launchers. (#1531, #1623, #1540, #1426) Thanks @evenafterallisaid, @Fazmin, @pionxzh, @xeropresence.
  • Reference imports: normalize internal symlink lookup consistently, preserve exact paths and exclusion provenance, report root access failures and reject FIFO replacements without blocking. (#1535, 2ca3ad2, 6636045, 3967cfa, f1c58cc) Thanks @anujsingh-cse.
  • Setup: honor active configuration and skill roots, preserve configured MCP environments, validate Hermes/OMP profiles before writing, recognize Omarchy and retain recovery backups. (#1504, #1607, #1528, #1562, #1662, a011485, #1606, #1521, #1561) Thanks @Adkid-Zephyr, @CassieFox23, @LuisTaffelli, @N0zoM1z0, @peter-research.
  • Process capture: retain descendant lineage after launcher exit, preserve identity uncertainty before signaling and release terminals after observation failures. (80896a1, c916850) Thanks @Y0UW1SH.
  • CLI/MCP errors: accept JSON files for web comparisons, preserve native option help and union correction details, remove invalid aliases and validate doctor against its discovered output contract. (#1397, #1395, #1425, #1461, 8b4c96e, #1421, #1454) Thanks @Fazmin, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.

⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

  • WebSocket results: use network.websocket_connections instead of network.websocket_events. Connections contain request_id, url and events; allow payload_bytes: null when size is unknown. No legacy alias remains. (db4e360)
  • Direct resource APIs: pass a caller-owned ArtifactResourceScope to inventory/extraction, JavaScript analysis, reference imports and web exports; retain it through cleanup/shutdown. For readJavaScriptArtifactFiles, scope is argument three and abort signal is argument four. Keep each root inventory source’s single cleanup owner. Use OwnedFileHandle owners, injected ASAR fd/read handles instead of createReadStream, VCS Result values, and WebScriptExportError’s options object. CLI/MCP inputs for the scoped operations are unchanged. (ffe0574, 53e7fad, 684199b, be75ed5, be6272f, e0e49e9, 95a77b6)
  • Saved reference graphs: exclusions require their matching pattern and distinguish project-ignored from default-ignored. Re-import graphs missing that provenance. (6585293)
  • Terminal captures: keep initial and resized buffers within 1,000,000 cells using columns × (rows + scrollback); oversized scenarios are rejected before launch. (f9ea9a9)
  • Optional agent-verification reports: accept schema version 4, nullable expectedFirstTool and targetClarificationPassed. Production CLI/MCP contracts are unchanged. (#1613)
  • Capture comparisons: recapture both sides with matching literal-replacements-v1 semantics when custom normalization patterns are used. Legacy unversioned pattern captures remain readable but cannot be compared with new pattern captures; captures without patterns are unaffected. (#1456, 2b6f14f) Thanks @Madhavan006, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Artifact graph edges: read child artifact IDs and paths from the occurrence selected by occurrence_id, not edge fields child_artifact_id/logical_path. Earlier inventory Evidence no longer validates against the new commitment. (#1493) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Semantic graph schema: nodes and relations no longer include identifier_strategy, and relation IDs no longer hash it. Earlier Evidence no longer validates against this schema. (#1474) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Semantic identities: select IDs from the parent graph; read exact event names from event_name, endpoints from endpoint and literal values from properties.value. New analyses use digest-based IDs for long/reserved event and endpoint names and value-sha256 literal role keys, with shorter labels; string literal labels now read string literal. Previously stored graphs retain their original IDs and remain valid workflow inputs. (#1427, #1423, #1407) Thanks @N0zoM1z0.

Contributors

  • Thanks also to @BaaRai, @commit-regrets, @coygeek, @Franky100-pig, @inii-sayaa, @jopemachine, @JosephDemarest, @keemsisi, @Totopo27 for contributions included in this release.

opendatalab/MinerU ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
mineru-4.0.12-releasedMinerU 4.0.12 Stable2026-10-11T02:21:42Z

更新内容 / What's Changed

新增 / Features

  • V1 API：自部署 API 与 Router 新增 /v1/tasks 异步便捷接口和 /v1/file_parse 同步包装，支持一次提交文件、查询状态及获取 JSON/ZIP 结果；与 /v1/parse/jobs 共用任务 ID / V1 API: add asynchronous /v1/tasks and synchronous /v1/file_parse convenience endpoints to self-hosted API servers and Routers, with one-request file submission, status queries and JSON/ZIP results sharing the existing parse-job IDs
  • 上传复用：支持 SHA-256 预检及已有 file_id 复用；原始字节入口在缓存命中时可提前返回，客户端示例见 scripts/http_task_example.sh / Upload reuse: support SHA-256 preflight and existing file_id references; the raw-byte endpoint can respond before reading the body on cache hits, with a client example in scripts/http_task_example.sh

改进 / Improvements

  • Router：按健康状态、解析能力及未完成任务负载调度，同负载轮询；完善跨 worker 输入复制、任务预占和失败/取消/终态后的负载释放 / Router: schedule by worker health, parsing capabilities and unfinished-job load, rotate among equal-load workers, and improve cross-worker input copying, reservations and load release
  • 资源保留：API 与 Router 默认在 24 小时后回收过期资源；可通过 --retention-seconds 或 MINERU_API_RETENTION_SECONDS 配置，设为 0 禁用自动回收 / Retention: API servers and Routers collect expired resources after 24 hours by default; configure --retention-seconds or MINERU_API_RETENTION_SECONDS, and use 0 to disable automatic collection
  • 模型生命周期：识别致命引擎错误并返回 503 engine_dead，托管 worker 支持代际恢复和退避，防止过期响应污染新 worker / Model lifecycle: detect fatal engine errors and return 503 engine_dead, recover managed worker generations with backoff, and reject stale responses
  • Torch CPU：按显式线程配置、有效 CPU 配额及已有线程上限限制算子线程，并传播到后续工作线程 / Torch CPU: cap operator threads using explicit settings, effective CPU quotas and existing lower limits, and apply the selected limit to subsequent worker threads
  • API 文档：Swagger/ReDoc 使用本地资源，支持离线访问、Bearer 授权及反向代理路径前缀 / API documentation: serve Swagger/ReDoc assets locally, with offline access, Bearer authorization and reverse-proxy path prefixes

修复 / Fixes

  • Router：任务保留期从跨 worker 副本清理完成后开始；过期回收及 worker 移除不再减少调用方累计用量；非法输出格式在 worker 调度前返回请求错误 / Router: start job retention after cross-worker input cleanup, preserve per-owner lifetime usage through collection and worker removal, and reject invalid output formats before worker selection
  • PDF：修复原生文本的中日韩边界标点和生成空格处理，统一 Python/Rust 路径；补充扫描件路由和原生表格模型回退回归 / PDF: repair CJK boundary punctuation and generated-space handling across Python/Rust paths, with regression coverage for scanned-PDF routing and native-table model fallback
  • 版面分析：恢复 PP-DocLayoutV2 的模型分类阈值，统一 Torch/ONNX 输出过滤与阅读顺序候选有效性 / Layout: restore PP-DocLayoutV2 model class thresholds and align Torch/ONNX output filtering with reading-order candidate validity
  • Office：通过 DocVortex 公共解析接口保留 DOCX/PPTX 表格内的富文本超链接 / Office: preserve rich-text hyperlinks in DOCX/PPTX tables through public DocVortex parsing interfaces

依赖 / Dependencies

  • docvortex 最低版本提升至 0.5.16（>=0.5.16,<1）/ Require docvortex>=0.5.16,<1
  • 新增 fastapi-offline（>=1.7.7,<2）/ Add fastapi-offline>=1.7.7,<2

升级提示 / Upgrade Notes

  • 便捷接口位于 V1 命名空间；同步等待超时返回 202 和任务引用，任务继续执行，客户端可继续查询结果 / Convenience endpoints use the V1 namespace; synchronous wait timeouts return 202 with task references while the task continues, so clients can keep polling for results
  • 长期保存产物时，请在资源保留期限内下载，或按部署需求调整保留时间 / Download outputs within the retention period for long-term storage, or adjust retention to suit your deployment

Full Changelog: https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/compare/mineru-4.0.11-released...mineru-4.0.12-released

studio-v2.35.0Reasonix Studio v2.35.0 Stable2026-10-11T02:06:32Z

本版加入 Linux 的 rpm 安装包、MCP 工具定义固定与变更扣留、闲置会话自动归档、硬件加速开关和反馈回复通知，并修复信任库无限增长、新会话默认模型被跳过时无提示等问题。

新增

  • 新增 Linux 的 .rpm 安装包（ReasonixStudio-linux-*.rpm），本版是首个含 rpm 的版本；用 minisign 校验，无 GPG 签名；rpm 安装的版本暂不自动更新 (#12608)
  • MCP 工具定义在你批准时被固定：之后有变化或新增的工具会被扣住，不进入模型请求，调用会被明确拒绝，直到用 reasonix mcp trust <名称> --digest <摘要> 批准；桌面端目前只显示通知 (#12597)
  • 设置的外观页新增「图形」：可关闭硬件加速（下次启动生效），并显示当前窗口的绘制方式；窗口无法绘制时，可用环境变量 REASONIX_DISABLE_GPU=1 或参数 --disable-gpu 仅关闭这一次 (#12451)
  • 设置新增可选的闲置会话自动归档（默认关闭，默认 30 天，范围 1 到 3650）；已置顶、正在运行、有待回答事项或有未读完成的会话不会被归档，归档可恢复 (#11535)
  • 反馈的未读角标在应用打开期间自动刷新，窗口不在前台时有新回复会弹出通知；通知设置里新增「反馈有回复时」开关，在总开关打开时默认开启 (#11538)
  • 设置的「关于」页新增「支持项目」入口，含 PayPal 链接以及默认折叠的微信、支付宝收款码 (#11709)

变更

  • 提交接口 POST /submit 只在提交确实被丢弃时返回 409；已受理并立刻结束的回合、排在结束中回合之后的提交现在返回 202 (#12596)
  • 电脑操作返回给模型的应用名和窗口标题现在限长并转义，包含换行或不可见字符的名称不再能伪造快照行 (#12585)
  • 安装 skill 或本地插件时，复制的来源若是指向目录的别名现在可以安装；批准之后来源别名被改指向别处，会被拒绝而不会复制 (#12112 by @KHG420)

修复

  • 信任库 trusted/ 目录不再无限增长：密封记录不再把合同的验收条目复制进每一回合，义务清单改为只存一份并按摘要引用 (#12609, Fixes #12603 fixed in #12609)
  • 新会话的默认模型是决策来源而被跳过时，终端界面和 reasonix run 现在给出「默认模型不可用」的通知，不再静默改用别的模型 (#12605 by @xxoingr)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@KHG420、@xxoingr

What's Changed

  • test(serve): wait for a trace turn to go silent, not for a fixed time by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12599
  • fix(repolint): wire-parity reads embedded structs and extends, declares PermissionRules by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12590
  • perf(gitcmd): skip the driver listing for subcommands that cannot run a driver by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12588
  • fix(computer): bound and escape application names in the snapshot and app list by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12585
  • fix(serve): judge POST /submit by what admission did with it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12596
  • feat(studio): opt-in archiving of conversations inactive for N days by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11535
  • fix(config): report a skipped default on the new-session path too by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12605
  • feat(studio): switch hardware acceleration off and show how the window is drawn by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12451
  • feat(release): build and publish an rpm of Studio for Linux by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12608
  • feat(feedback): refresh the unread badge while open and announce new replies by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11538
  • feat(studio): add a Support entry to Settings > About by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11709
  • fix(installsource): copy directory root aliases by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12112
  • fix(agent): stop copying the contract's criteria into every sealed bundle by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12609
  • feat(plugin): pin MCP tool definitions at approval and hold changed tools by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12597
  • docs(release): Studio 2.35.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12610

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.34.0...studio-v2.35.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。
