studio-v2.34.0Reasonix Studio v2.34.0 Stable2026-10-10T15:01:22Z

本版让输入框可以直接切换工作区的本地分支，界面缩放改用统一范围并支持 Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0，电脑操作能判断每一步是否生效，并修复回退冲突、旧版会话导入、模型切换、GLM 思考参数和多处终端界面的问题。

新增

  • 输入框的分支标签读取真实的 git 状态，并可直接把工作区切换到另一个本地分支；有进行中的回合、后台任务或未提交改动时会明确拒绝并说明原因 (#12092 by @XTLine, #12171 by @XTLine)
  • 界面缩放只有一个声明范围 0.8 到 1.8（步长 0.05），滑块显示的值就是实际保存的值，并可用 Ctrl/Cmd 加 +、-、0 调整 (#12035)
  • 电脑操作的每一步会标明效果是否可信，并带上占住输入的模态对话框；Windows 上输入文字会读回确认，被错误框挡住时不再假装成功 (#12541, #12542)
  • 自动压缩因上次摘要失败而被暂缓时，界面和终端界面会显示一条中英文提示，不再静默 (#12083)
  • 终端界面输入框为空时按回车，回到最新输出并继续跟随，与 1.x 一致；Ctrl+Z 把终端界面挂起到命令行，fg 后恢复 (#12510 by @xxoingr, #12511 by @xxoingr)
  • 思考参数面板按协议声明的字段命名，Responses 协议的服务商不再显示成只支持 Chat (#12498)

变更

  • 侧栏底部的用量、反馈、账号和设置，在图标栏可见时不再重复显示；图标栏隐藏、仅折叠时显示或窄窗口下仍保留 (#12482 by @SivanCola)
  • 显式声明 glm 协议的服务，glm-5.2、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 的请求现在带 reasoning_effort：5.2 选 high 真发 high，选 none 真关思考；5.3 的「关闭」发 thinking=enabled 加 low (#12552)
  • 决策来源不再出现在输入框的模型切换器里，选它会得到明确错误，而不是不可预期的失败 (#12553)
  • 已保存的决策来源点「测试连接」时，改走它自己的协议并给出分类错误，不再提示「加 /v1」 (#12546)
  • 配置编辑锁目录改放在用户主目录下，遇到属于他人的目录时给出明确错误，不再报一个裸的权限错误 (#11374 by @drakeo338)
  • 权限规则写成不对应任何已注册工具的裸命令（如 ask = ["rm"]）时会被报告并拒绝，不再静默失效 (#12536)
  • 安装计划里来自软件包的文字（版本、名称、路径、警告等）现在限长并清除控制字符，.mcp.json 声明的服务数超限会被拒绝 (#12037, #12512 by @xxoingr)

修复

  • 代码回退之后再次回退同一回合或更早的回合，不再误报文件冲突；回退确认里的文件数按整个回退范围统计 (#11572 by @Guan0923, #11692 by @Guan0923)
  • 打开 1.x 会话时不再多出一份同名副本 (#12506)
  • 导入 1.x 目录时，读不了的会话会逐条列出并附带原因，不再只给一个警告数量 (#12538)
  • 模型切换被拒时区分是回合仍在运行还是只剩后台任务，并说明各自的处理办法 (#12505)
  • 模型切换后，已接入的拦截器类扩展不再失效，也不再误报其服务已停止 (#12367 by @KHG420)
  • Windows 上通过注册表里的安装路径找到 Git Bash，回退到 PowerShell 时明确告知；外壳探测有时限且结果会保存，不再拖慢启动 (#12486, #12539)
  • Git 低于 2.31 时，工作区不再被误判为「不是仓库」而丢失状态、提交和分支标签 (#12518)
  • 压缩摘要因输出上限被截断时，自动用加倍的上限重试一次 (#12469)
  • 计划模式拒绝调用时，说明被拒的命令、原因类别和可行的出路 (#12517)
  • 本回合只改了 .md/.rst 文档时，不再被要求运行验证命令 (#12520)
  • 交付卡片不再把主机自己的任务快照、工具缓存和 .git 当作改动，也不再给中文用户显示英文句子 (#12465)
  • 后台任务完成、终止、失败的提示改为按界面语言显示 (#12476)
  • 提问卡片的自由文字输入框始终可见，运行状态明确写为等待你的回答 (#12540)
  • 图标栏的悬停提示不再被裁掉或被遮住 (#12468)
  • 重写已发送消息的输入框与队列行的编辑框随文字长度调整高度，长段落不再只露出两行 (#12477)
  • 记忆页保存时，较新的草稿不会被先前的保存完成而清掉，各条记忆的写入按钮分别保持禁用 (#12135 by @KHG420)
  • 切换设置里的连接后，软件包安装表单和更新锁不再沿用上一个连接的内容 (#12126 by @KHG420)
  • 技能安装和注册的结果只报告所选来源自己的文件，同名技能被遮蔽时给出警告，目录别名也会被跟随 (#12107 by @KHG420, #12109 by @KHG420, #12110 by @KHG420)
  • memory 工具的搜索和列表在丢弃结果时会注明丢了多少条，模型不再把截断当作完整 (#12104 by @chuiwenwei)
  • 宿主日志不再被例行请求刷满，内核异常退出时留下可读的崩溃记录 (#12523)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@XTLine、@xxoingr、@SivanCola、@drakeo338、@Guan0923、@KHG420、@chuiwenwei

What's Changed

  • fix(studio): keep adopted interceptors working after model switches by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12367
  • docs(readme): add a sponsor slot for PackyCode by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12470

  • fix(installsource): bound and sanitise package-supplied preview text by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12037
  • fix(studio): read the composer branch from git, not the capability scope by @XTLine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12092
  • fix(composer): size the rewrite box to its text, as the composer does by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12477
  • feat(providers): word the thinking parameter from the protocol's declared effort field by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12498
  • feat(session): check the workspace out to another local branch by @XTLine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12171
  • fix(session): opening a 1.x conversation no longer forks a copy by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12506
  • fix(serve): say whether a turn or leftover background jobs block a model switch by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12505
  • fix(tui): Enter on an empty composer returns to the newest output by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12510
  • fix(tui): Ctrl+Z suspends the TUI to the shell by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12511
  • fix(gitcmd): resolve repository paths without rev-parse --path-format by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12518
  • ci: raise the Windows package timeout to 18m and print the slowest boot tests on failure by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12525
  • fix(readiness): waive the verification ask when every change this turn is prose by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12520
  • fix(installsource): refuse a .mcp.json with more servers than the limit by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12512
  • fix(host): quiet routine request logging and keep a crash trail when the kernel dies by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12523
  • perf(control): read the config for image routing only when a turn has attachments by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12529
  • perf(skill): resolve each discovery root once per pass by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12530
  • fix(permissions): report and refuse rules that name no registered tool by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12536
  • fix(studio): consolidate sidebar footer entries / 合并侧栏重复底部入口 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12482
  • fix(import): list the 1.x sessions an import could not read, with a typed reason by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12538
  • fix(studio): make the ask card's free-text answer discoverable and name the wait by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12540
  • fix(boot): bound and persist Windows shell discovery so the handshake is not held behind it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12539
  • feat(computer): grade each step's effect and carry the modal that holds input by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12541
  • fix(planmode): a refused call names its command, cause class and way out by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12517
  • feat(computer-helper/windows): report modals and grade typing by read-back by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12542
  • fix(installsource): follow skill collection root aliases by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12110
  • test(installsource): make the alias quoting fixture creatable on Windows by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12579
  • fix(studio): count files across the full rewind range by @Guan0923 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11692
  • fix(providers): verify a decision source through its own protocol, not a model listing by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12546
  • fix(models): a decision source is not offered, or accepted, as a conversation model by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12553
  • fix(effort): apply the GLM depth contract by declared protocol, not host by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12552
  • docs(release): Studio 2.34.0 release notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12583

New Contributors

  • @f1shsmell made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12389

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.33.0...studio-v2.34.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux 从 .deb 安装。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 走自己的包，Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

Graphify-Labs/graphify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.85 Stable2026-10-10T21:32:31Z

A language-extraction and tooling batch: six extractor/exporter fixes picked from open issues, plus fourteen community pull requests.

  • Fix: Julia functions with a where clause (long and short form) and parametric type definitions (struct Box{T}, abstract type Shape{T}, struct Sq{T} <: Shape{T}) are now extracted. The name sat inside a where_expression / parametrized_type_expression wrapper that the name lookup skipped, so the whole method/type was dropped; a declared type parameter (value::T) no longer leaks as a phantom field-type node (#4126, #4128).
  • Fix: Fortran a named generic interface now gets a callable node and a dispatches_to edge to each listed module procedure, so a call to the generic name resolves instead of dangling; unnamed and operator/assignment interfaces are unaffected (#4141, #4142, thanks @rajatnagda45).
  • Fix: Elixir defdelegate is now extracted as a function definition, so the delegated function appears and same-module calls to it resolve (#4132).
  • Fix: Scala 3 given ... with instance methods are scoped to the given instead of leaking to file scope (where they collided with the same-named trait type); an anonymous given Show[Int] with keeps its members under a synthesized name (#4130).
  • Fix: graph.html a node label containing an unclosed <!-- then <script can no longer break out of the embedded data script and blank the page; every < in the embedded JSON is escaped (#4124).
  • Fix: the incomplete-extraction message now explains a pure semantic omission (a smaller --token-budget is the lever) instead of always blaming truncation (#4101, #4280, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: TypeScript export type * star re-exports no longer trip a spurious syntax-error flag that skewed the health report (#3942, #4303, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: Rust a cross-file reference to a type with impl blocks in other files now binds to the single declaration instead of a sourceless stub, fail-closed (#4283, #4284, thanks @Alin1233).
  • Fix: distinct files that mint the same node id after the extension is dropped (x.py vs x.html) are kept as separate nodes instead of collapsing and losing one (#4281, #4282, thanks @bitwizard25).
  • Fix: the git hook now updates the graph for files whose names contain non-ASCII characters (core.quotePath=false plus C-quote decoding) (#4278, #4279, thanks @smngvlkz).
  • Fix: watch the rebuild lock no longer unlinks on release while a waiter holds it, closing a race that let two rebuilds run at once (POSIX) (#4273, #4277, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: an unanchored ignore pattern is now matched against the entry name only (so * no longer crosses / and negations behave like git) (#4242, #4251, thanks @Yyunozor).
  • Fix: the hook-guard Read nudge now fires for PowerShell source files (.ps1/.psm1/.psd1) (#4271, #4272, thanks @rtmalikian).
  • Fix: the skill now tells you that graphify-out/ was written into your working tree, with how to gitignore or share it (#3941, #4308, thanks @eoinforker).
  • Fix: graphify affected <Symbol> now reaches callers through the symbol's defining file, so Dart/Flutter (and other file-module languages) return results instead of nothing (#4288, #4290, thanks @dcaldr).
  • Fix: an export default with a huge base64 literal plus a tsconfig baseUrl no longer crashes extraction with "File name too long" (#4166, #4169, thanks @bastiennoel93).
  • Fix: markdown links to a file name containing a space ([x](<My Note.md>), [x](My%20Note.md)) now resolve to a references edge (#4177, #4178, thanks @Yyunozor).
  • Perf: skip a per-call os.getcwd() in the path-memo key for absolute paths, and walk each JS/TS tree once when collecting symbol facts — both output-identical (#4301, #4302, thanks @pishuv).

[2.12.3]

Bug Fixes

  • 0204f6f3a (#16244) Keep delivering Channel messages after the onmessage handler throws. The error is rethrown asynchronously so it is still reported as uncaught, instead of leaving every later message queued.
  • c48e1ca89 (#16246) On iOS, mark the Swift @_cdecl entry points that Rust links against as public (in the iOS API and in the plugin templates), so release builds made with Xcode 27 keep them global and link.
  • eeeaa0ff9 (#16230) Fix NSIS installers not blocking downgrades in silent (/S), passive (/P) and update (/UPDATE) modes when bundle.windows.allowDowngrades is false.

Dependencies

  • Upgraded to tauri-macros@2.7.2
  • Upgraded to tauri-build@2.7.2

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.8CC Switch v4.0.8 Stable2026-10-10T15:51:15Z

CC Switch v4.0.8

4.0 正式版的第四个修复版本

只装了 Codex 桌面版、没有单独装 Codex 命令行的用户，现在也能用 Codex 聚合模式了。官方模型列表读不到时，提示会写明原因，问题解决后提示也会自己消失。添加和编辑供应商时，「获取模型列表」会带上你配置的请求头，需要额外请求头的网关不会再拒绝。「设置 → 数据」新增「打开日志」按钮。深色模式的文字调暗了一些，不再那么刺眼。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

「设置 → 数据 → 应用诊断日志」新增「打开日志」按钮。 点击后会在系统的文件管理器里选中 cc-switch.log；日志文件还没生成时打开日志所在的文件夹。报告问题时可以直接把它附上，不用再去找隐藏的配置目录。

修复

  • 只装了 Codex 桌面版时，聚合页提示「读取不到 Codex 模型列表」，聚合模式用不了。 联网获取官方列表失败时，CC Switch 会改用 Codex 命令行自带的模型列表，但以前只在系统路径里找 codex 命令。只装桌面版的用户没有这个命令，所以一直失败。现在找不到时会再去用 Codex 桌面版自带的命令行：macOS 上找「应用程序」里的 ChatGPT.app 和改名前的 Codex.app，两个都在时用 ChatGPT.app，避免旧的 Codex.app 给出过时的模型列表；Windows 上找桌面版安装目录里最新的一个版本。单独安装的 Codex 命令行仍然优先。
  • 官方模型列表读不到时，提示看不出原因，问题解决后提示也不会消失。 以前所有原因都显示成同一句「读取不到 Codex 模型列表」。现在提示下面会列出具体原因，并告诉你怎么处理：Codex 没有可用的 ChatGPT 登录、登录超过 8 天没有刷新、登录信息不完整、读不到 Codex 版本、联网获取失败、返回的数据不完整；Codex 自带的列表则分为找不到 Codex 命令行、命令行没能输出列表、列表里没有能用的模型。联网失败和命令行失败的详细信息会写进日志。另外，以前换用备用列表后，即使官方列表后来恢复了（比如过期的登录被 Codex 自动刷新），提示也要等你下次手动切换才会消失；现在 CC Switch 会自动换回官方列表，提示随之消失。
  • 「获取模型列表」不带你配置的请求头，需要额外请求头的网关会拒绝。 比如 Cloudflare AI Gateway 要求 cf-aig-authorization 请求头。现在 OpenCode 供应商会带上它配置的请求头；Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok Build 供应商会带上「Header 覆盖」里填的请求头，格式不对或留空时照常获取。在 Codex 和 Grok Build 的表单里修改「Header 覆盖」后，已经获取的模型列表会清空，避免选到当前身份用不了的模型。
  • 深色模式的文字太亮，看久了刺眼。 三档文字颜色都接近纯白，满屏表格和标签时显得很冲，主次也分不清。现在三档都调暗了一些，次要文字在卡片和选中背景上仍然保持足够的对比度。浅色模式没有变化。

其他：

  • v4.0.7 发布说明里「压缩 Codex 历史会话」一节补充了怎么打开、什么时候压缩、怎么继续旧会话、CC Switch 里怎么显示和需要注意的地方。
  • 英文和日文的额度显示说明、英文、日文和繁体中文的备份提示，改用界面上实际显示的名称。

升级说明

数据库结构没有变化，仍然是 20。

致谢

感谢 @SailingLoong（OpenCode 获取模型列表时带上请求头）、@ggbdpq（Claude Code、Codex 获取模型列表时带上「Header 覆盖」）的贡献。

感谢 @xovow、@YX-bobi、@cydebbb 报告问题和提出建议。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。
